Since first breaking in as the writer of his self-published Battle Pope, ROBERT KIRKMAN
has been a strident proponent of creator-owned comics. Making his home at Image Comics

Team-Up, The Irredeemable Ant-Man, Punisher War Journal, and Shadowpact in addition
